findings.title: quote throws an un-coded TypeError for a null request
findings.evidence: validateRequest destructures its argument before checking its fields. Calling quote(null) therefore throws a native TypeError before fail('INVALID_INPUT') can run. This is reproducible through the public API.
findings.suggestion: Check that the request is a non-null, non-array object before destructuring, and throw INVALID_INPUT otherwise.

references.quote: quote and redeem reject invalid request fields with INVALID_INPUT

oracle.explanation: null is not a valid quote request, so the public API should throw an Error whose code is INVALID_INPUT.

replay.message: Sai khác tại S-1; đối chiếu oracle trước khi xác nhận finding.
